exposure: Cardiac disease (congenital heart disease, arrhythmia, valvular heart disease, ischemic heart disease, cardiomyopathy, pericardial disease)
outcome: Use of epidural analgesia during vaginal delivery
cohort: 94,364 pregnant women who underwent high-risk delivery due to obstetric or non-obstetric comorbidities in Japan between 2008 and 2014
finding: Pregnant women with pre-existing cardiac disease are at a higher risk of heart failure during the peripartum period than those with non-cardiac comorbidities.
